text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release/2026.3 in eu-west-1 (canary id: canary-2026.3-eu1). Monitoring metrics and health checks.
Alex: seeing a small 5xx spike on the canary - error rate ~3% and tail latency +70ms. Paging oncall.
Danielle: oncall here, taking pager. What's the impact surface?
Alex: requests failing are mainly embeddings endpoint; traces point to tokenizer step. Affected requests from a single org so far.
Maya: checking logs — NPE in tokenizer from commit abc123 (recent change in tokenizer fallback).
Danielle: can we toggle the rollout flag or kill the canary? Need to stop blast radius.
Maya: we have a kill-switch on the rollout. I can flip it in the console. Ready?
Alex: do it. Confirm we keep existing stable version serving.
Maya: flipped rollout kill-switch for canary-2026.3-eu1 -> traffic 0%. Deploy routing reverted to stable.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic set to 0% for canary-2026.3-eu1. Notifying stakeholders.
Luca: CS ping — customer 8675 opened a ticket about 502s, marked as high. I’m reaching out with a status update.
Danielle: thanks Luca. We need a short-term mitigation and a patch plan. Maya, is a revert feasible?
Maya: yes, the fix is a single commit revert (revert abc123). I can prepare a hotpatch build and run a quick canary.
Ravi: I’ll build hotpatch image and push to canary cluster; ETA ~8min. Building now.
Ravi: build done, pushing hotpatch image hotpatch/2026.3.1 -> starting canary deploy.
deploy-bot: Hotpatch canary deploy started (hotpatch id: 2026.3.1-canary).
Alex: instrumenting traces and tail latency dashboards. Will watch error rate and partial-trace failures.
Danielle: communicate timeline to CS: hotpatch canary -> if green, promote and then roll forward.
Luca: told customer we’ve paused rollout and are deploying a hotpatch; will follow up in 15m with status.
Alex: error rate on hotpatch canary trending down, now 0.1% and tail lat back to baseline.
Maya: running a few smoke requests and targeted fuzz tests against the tokenizer path — all good.
Ravi: promoting hotpatch to stable in eu-west-1 now.
deploy-bot: Promotion initiated: hotpatch 2026.3.1 -> stable. Rollout traffic ramping.
Alex: metrics look healthy during ramp, no regression in next-closest regions.
Danielle: great. Marking incident as mitigated. Follow-up actions: postmortem, add unit test for tokenizer fallback, and make revert orthogonal to canary health checks.
Luca: CS: customer notified that issue resolved and we offered a credit; they acknowledged, will wait for postmortem.
Maya: noting root cause: tokenizer null-path hit due to assumption in abc123; include patch + tests in PR.
Alex: handing off monitoring to night on-call @Jordan for 2h observation window. Jordan pls ack.
Jordan: Jordan: acked, will watch dashboards and leave notes in the incident doc.
deploy-bot: Incident thread closed for active mitigation. Tagging for postmortem and severity review.
